title.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: ONE standalone 320x192 illustration panel for the title screen of Feldmarschall, an early 19th century Prussian strategy game on Commander X16. Wide landscape aspect ratio exactly 5:3. Scene: an imposing Prussian field marshal in bicorne and dark high-collared Napoleonic uniform occupies the right half, three-quarter bust portrait facing left, calm focused expression before a campaign, not celebrating or grieving. On the left a Prussian eagle standard with a readable dark eagle silhouette on muted ivory cloth rises over small disciplined infantry formations, distant cannon silhouettes and a low battlefield horizon. Quiet golden dawn breaking through cool slate smoke; restrained brass embroidery, small muted red collar accents. Strong readable portrait and banner silhouettes at very small resolution. Style: refined 1990s strategy-game pixel art combined with an engraved military portrait, large hard pixel clusters, controlled hatching and sparse stippling, clean forms, no smooth photographic or painterly gradients. Composition optimized for subsequent 320x192 conversion. Color palette intent: at most 16 flat shades, pure black #000000, charcoal, dark slate, muted teal-gray, brass, warm gold #DDBB66 and restrained red #BB3322, highlights muted ivory. All image edges and deep negative space pure black, illustration fading gently into black, modest safe margin around the portrait and standard. No frame, border, lettering, title, words, UI, collage, watermarks, or gore. The crisp title typography and gold frame will be added algorithmically outside this panel.

Add just a short, narrow, plain gold fastening loop above it, ending in a small brass button below or at the rosette. Remove the dangling gold decorative strands below the old ornament and restore the surrounding dark felt texture. Retain the hat's bicorne silhouette and gold brim edging exactly. Keep ALL other artwork unchanged: marshal face, expression, pose, uniform and red collar, flag/eagle, soldiers, dawn sky, pixel engraving textures, black background, composition and 5:3 landscape aspect. Keep restrained pixel-art forms readable after conversion to 320x192. No new text, frame, objects, plumes or watermark. This corrects the cockade colors for Napoleonic-era Prussia; do not introduce a red-white-black imperial cockade.
